fields.title: A refund reaches the PSP within the hour
fields.target: 95% of refunds submitted to the PSP within one hour of the return being accepted
fields.measured-by: Application Insights, on the gap between the return event and the refund request at svc-payment-api

sections.Target: 95% of refunds within one hour, measured over a rolling day, from the return being accepted to [svc-payment-api](https://github.com/paul80nd/knowledge-as-code/blob/ff4b98f7e832260c4bde38430bf3d834389bc50c/examples/payments/services/payment-api.md) submitting the refund to the PSP.
sections.Why this number:
The card scheme takes between three and five working days to move the money, and this estate cannot change that. An hour is what [svc-payment-api](https://github.com/paul80nd/knowledge-as-code/blob/ff4b98f7e832260c4bde38430bf3d834389bc50c/examples/payments/services/payment-api.md) can promise for the part it does control, so a return accepted during a working day is submitted the same day. The money arriving in the customer's account is deliberately not committed, because the scheme decides when that happens.

The remaining 5% covers a return accepted during a deployment of [svc-payment-ledger](https://github.com/paul80nd/knowledge-as-code/blob/ff4b98f7e832260c4bde38430bf3d834389bc50c/examples/payments/services/payment-ledger.md), the only shape of failure `Current actual` records so far.
sections.How it is measured: Application Insights records both moments against the payment id. The payments dashboard shows the rolling day, and the same query runs in the monthly service review.
sections.What a breach costs: A customer who has returned goods and seen nothing calls the contact centre on the second day. Support learns of a sustained breach before finance does.
sections.What we do about a breach: An alert fires where the figure falls below 95% for two consecutive hours and pages the on-call engineer. The engineer reads the deployment history of [svc-payment-ledger](https://github.com/paul80nd/knowledge-as-code/blob/ff4b98f7e832260c4bde38430bf3d834389bc50c/examples/payments/services/payment-ledger.md) first.
sections.Constraints: The PSP accepts a refund only against a captured payment, and [ofr-card-payment](https://github.com/paul80nd/knowledge-as-code/blob/ff4b98f7e832260c4bde38430bf3d834389bc50c/examples/payments/offerings/card-payment.md) captures the payment when the order ships. The hour therefore presumes a payment that has already been captured.
